name: AEGIS-M - Integrated Air Defence Framework
author: Snow(Dryden)
scope: Selective AI anti-air improvements integrated into normal CBE behaviour without requiring placed/synced modules. Not a wholesale port or external addon dependency.
includedIntent: Shoot down incoming munitions where supported by weapon/platform capabilities.
Coordinate multiple AA assets in a group as layered defence with complementary coverage and engagement allocation.
Human-feeling crews: bounded reaction, skill and temperament effects without omniscience or overwriting mission-authored skill.
Evaluate CIWS aim correction methods for useful intent, weapon feasibility, fairness and native firing authority.
Prioritise threats to the defended AA asset/network, including incoming threats; rank using observed threat, urgency and uncertainty.
excludedIntent: Source module placement/synchronisation requirement, network construction workflow and general module suite.
Unrelated player-facing features, source-specific compatibility expansion and wholesale feature replication.
evaluationTopics: Trace detection, track sharing, interception, target allocation, crew decision timing and aim correction across complete execution paths.
Use native/observed knowledge and finite track freshness; prevent perfect global detection and duplicate allocation.
Respect individual/group fire policy, locality, specialist ownership, ammunition and friendly safety.
Inspect whether correction changes turret aim or projectile physics; do not assume all source methods are suitable. Reject manufactured hits or unsafe ballistics changes.
Bound projectile/threat scans, scheduling and tracking work; compose existing CBE owner-local FSMs instead of competing fire controllers.
Revalidate group membership, asset loss, ammunition exhaustion, interrupted orders and repeated engagements.
identityEvidence: Installed mod.cpp and meta.cpp confirm name, author and publishedid. Metadata describes radar/SAM/CIWS/CRAM networks and crew skill/temperament; individual capabilities requested by user remain unverified pending source review.
sourceProtection: Read installed originals only; preserve archives and provenance. Keep raw upstream material private and outside CBE packages.
masterLedger: Historical LOCAL_IMPLEMENTATION_LEDGER.md absent; preserve addition separately for reconciliation.
acceptance: No implementation, parity or physical validation claimed; audits PAUSED.
